attributes.name: Rahadoumi Captain
attributes.powers:
Before you act, recharge a card that has the Pirate or Swashbuckling trait, if you have one, then summon and encounter the ship Man's Promise. The difficulty of the check to defeat the ship Man's Promise is increased by the number of characters at your location.

"Pirates astern! Prepare to repel boarders!"—Rahadoumi Captain
